text: System F (the polymorphic lambda calculus of Girard–Reynolds) extends the simply typed lambda calculus with:
choices: dependent types, in which types may mention values
general recursion via a fix operator
identity types and the univalence axiom
universal quantification over types (∀α. A) with type abstraction Λα.t and type application t [A]
explanation: System F adds type variables and universal quantification over types, ∀α.A, with term-level type abstraction Λα.t and type application t [A]; it corresponds to second-order logic. Dependent types (A) are the further Π/Σ extension, not System F; System F is still strongly normalizing so it has no general fix (B); identity types and univalence (C) belong to homotopy type theory.
